units.source_text: 无聊之极，只得到尼姑三公主那里走走。

en.t: Utterly bored, he could only go and visit the nun, the Third Princess.

units.source_text: 三皇子由侍女抱着同去，到了那里，就和薰君一起追逐玩耍，方才那种惜花的心情不知哪里去了，毕竟还是个无知幼儿。

en.t: The Third Prince was carried along by a lady-in-waiting, and once they arrived, he ran about playing chase with Lord Kaoru; the tender feeling he had just shown for the flowers vanished completely, for after all he was still an ignorant little child.

units.source_text: 三公主正在佛前诵经。

en.t: The Third Princess was reciting sutras before the Buddha.

units.source_text: 她当初出家，并非由于彻悟人生、深通佛道。

en.t: When she first took religious vows, it was not because she had fully awakened to life or deeply understood the Buddhist path.

units.source_text: 然而对于此世，爱恨全消，一心不乱，只管深居静处，专心修持，已经离绝红尘，献身佛法了。

en.t: Yet toward this world, love and hatred had both disappeared; with an undistracted heart she lived quietly in seclusion, devoted herself to practice, and had already left the dust of the world behind to give herself to the Dharma.

units.source_text: 源氏很羡慕她。

en.t: Genji greatly envied her.

units.source_text: 他想：“我的道心还赶不上这个浅薄的女子呢。”

en.t: He thought, "My own aspiration for the Way does not even measure up to that of this shallow woman."

units.source_text: 心中颇感惭愧。

en.t: He felt deeply ashamed in his heart.

units.source_text: 忽见佛前所供的花，映着夕阳，非常美观，便对三公主说道：“爱春的人死了，花都减色了！

en.t: Suddenly he noticed the flowers offered before the Buddha, beautiful in the evening sun, and said to the Third Princess, "The one who loved spring has died, and even the flowers have lost their color!

units.source_text: 只有这佛前的供饰，还很美观。”

en.t: Only these offerings before the Buddha are still beautiful."

units.source_text: 又说：“她屋前那株棣棠花，姿态之优美竟是世间少有的。

en.t: He added, "That kerria before her room was so graceful in form that its beauty was rare in this world.

units.source_text: 花穗多么大啊！

en.t: How large its clusters of blossoms were!

units.source_text: 棣棠的品质算不得高尚，但其浓艳之色是可取的。

en.t: The kerria cannot be called a flower of noble character, but its rich, vivid color is worthy of admiration.

units.source_text: 种花的人已经死去，而春天只当作不知，开得比往年更加茂盛，真可怜啊！”

en.t: The one who planted it has already died, yet spring behaves as though it knows nothing and makes it bloom more luxuriantly than ever; how pitiful!"

units.source_text: 三公主不假思索地念出两句古歌：“谷里无天日，春来总不知。”

en.t: Without a moment's thought, the Third Princess recited two lines from an old poem: "No sunlight reaches the valley, so it never knows when spring has come."

units.source_text: 源氏想道：“可回答的话多着呢， 何必说这扫兴的话？”

en.t: Genji thought, "There are so many ways she could have answered; why say something so dispiriting?"

units.source_text: 便回思紫夫人生前：“从幼年起，无论何事，凡我心中不喜爱的，她从来不做。

en.t: Then he remembered Lady Murasaki while she was alive: "From childhood on, whatever the matter was, she never did anything that I disliked.

units.source_text: 她能适应种种时机，断然地敏捷地对付一切事情。

en.t: She could adapt to every occasion and deal with everything decisively and swiftly.

units.source_text: 其气质、态度和言语都富有风趣。”

en.t: Her nature, her manner, and her words were all full of charm."

units.source_text: 他本是容易流泪的人，思量至此，眼泪又夺眶而出，真乃太痛苦了。

en.t: He was by nature quick to tears, and when his thoughts reached this point, tears again spilled from his eyes; it was truly unbearable.
